messages.subject: Project Zephyr — indicative term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Sandra, Tom,

Following the NDA, please find attached our indicative (non-binding) term sheet for the Helmsman licence. Headline numbers: £4.5m upfront, £950k annual licence fee, three deployment milestones of £1m each, plus a running royalty on net benefit value (we've proposed 5.0% capped at £2m p.a.). Seven-year term, with a three-year exclusivity in your multi-channel retail fulfilment field.

It's subject to contract and to the FTO position, but it should give us a frame for the long-form. Happy to walk through on a call.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate & Technology
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0519

This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thanks. Broadly workable from an operations standpoint — the milestone structure maps well onto our rollout (Daventry pilot, then Lutterworth + Peterborough). Commercially we'll want to push on the royalty rate and the liability cap; Sandra and Alistair Whitlock (our counsel at Pemberton Rowe) will lead on the legal mark-up. We're keen to keep the Jan pilot date.

Tom Reddick
Head of Automation, Wexbourne Retail Group
